preservation_contract: Every declared input can be reconstructed from an exact archived historical Git blob or the byte-identical shared delivery file. Original code, source fingerprints and raw are unchanged; old scratch commit references are provenance labels, not a claim those commits are ancestors of delivery.
execution_policy: Historical harnesses include known-broken/rejected source versions. They are data for review, not executable authority. Never run a historical capsule or reuse any spent runroot/budget. No script, PID denylist, CLI flag or metadata file grants permission to start processes or signals.
private_policy: Private52-record original native journal, full raw reports and business data/DB/keys are absent from Git. Only safe allowlist export, original safe text raw and metadata/hash evidence are imported.
